notes.title: Week 1 Update: We’ve Got A Brand New Map For You!
notes.content:
Soldiers,



It’s been a week since the start of our first offensive, and we’ve got a little surprise to keep morale high…

Introducing: Barricade Bridge
Barricade Bridge is a brand-new Capture & Hold map set on a mighty steel bridge! Hovering over a cascading river, your aim is to fight your way through a confined space and gain control over the bridge.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/25a59de0c3f907a2b95cc15bfd8a63fba4bb7efa.png"]One perfectly timed clap and you can catapult your enemies into the current, one misstep and you’re the one going for a swim. It’s a high-octane, high-stakes battle for control. And it’s loads of fun.


Tweaks to the Server System

We’ve noticed that a lot of you have been running into issues with our server browser, specifically when it comes to finding games in other regions. That’s why we’ve implemented a brand-new subsystem allowing for non-region locked servers and ping measurements. You’ll finally be able to play with your friends in different parts of the world and freely choose the server that best suits your needs! 

Headshotting your friend on the other side of the globe sounds fun, doesn’t it? 


A Small Thank You


We decided to drop an update so soon after release as a small thank you note to the community. It’s been one week since we’ve released into Early Access and your reaction has been overwhelming! From the frenzied discussions on Discord, to the huge amount of reviews you guys left on our store page, we want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/311bf2cde873db7afe9eb1bc71bf84244f3713fb.png"]Don’t worry, we’ve already celebrated with some Belgian beers. But we also wanted you to have something to celebrate with, so we hope you’ll enjoy the new map! 


That’s it for now, soldiers! We’re steadily cranking out bug fixes & improvements, so if you find anything that’s FUBAR, hop on our Discord or on Steam Discussions to let us know. And of course, we’re also sneakily grinding away at our next big Roadmap update… 


Patch notes: 

New map: Barricade Bridge (Capture & Hold)

New online subsystem which allows for global non region locked servers and ping measurements

Tweaked some networking setting that smooth out gameplay a bit more (might still need more tweaks)

Fixed motorcycle out of combat and death from exiting bug

Fixed potential similar issue with tanks and planes

Increased launch force on enemies from all types of explosions with 50%

Fixed bots sometimes still showing a golden name in scoreboard


We can’t wait to share all the cool stuff we’re working on! 
Fancy Cat Interactive

notes.title: Join the Fight: Heroes of Valor is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.content:
Fall in, soldier! It’s time to lace up your combat boots and put on your dinosaur mask. Welcome to war!   

Heroes of Valor is OUT NOW in Early Access!  

[previewyoutube="5sV1qLXbR3E;full"][/previewyoutube]

You can now pick up Heroes of Valor for €14,79/$14,99/£12,79, with a 10% launch discount! And if you wanna support the development of this game a little more, you can grab the Heroes of Valor Decorated Supporter Pack for $7.99/£6.69/€7.79! 

If you pick up the game, make sure to leave a review! It's the easiest way for you to support us, by helping us get the game in front of as many eyes as possible. 

Roadmap
We’ve decided to release Heroes of Valor in Early Access, because we felt like there was a lot of unique, exciting content that we still wanted to add to the game – and we felt like doing alongside you would be a lot more fun.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/c71263b5369c9a421b01159722b510e19cc983e8.png"]

We’re sure that Early Access content has been a burning question on everybody’s mind, so we’ve put together this roadmap so you can see what brand-new stuff you can expect as we keep working on the game! From new classes, to war bonds, to seasonal events, we have a lot of big guns in the pipeline, and we think you’ll enjoy them as much as we do. We know this is not the most precise roadmap out there, but we wanna keep the element of surprise on our side. As we get closer to each phase, we’ll reveal more about what’s gonna be in each update. So keep your eyes peeled! 

But like… what IS Heroes of Valor?
Right, we forgot that some of you are new here. Let me recap: Heroes of Valor is a chaotic, stylized WWII shooter. We’re launching with four maps, three classes, and a boatload of weapons and cosmetics. Customize your Hero, pick your team, and join the fray! 

Flying bullets, roaring tanks, and planes swarm everywhere. In Heroes of Valor, there's no room for hesitation. Blow your enemies to smithereens and take home the win for your platoon. 


Got it? Good. See you on the front. 

Fancy Cat Interactive


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504090/Heroes_of_Valor/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Dress to Impress with the Decorated Supporter Pack DLC!
notes.content:
Heroism. Fearlessness. Bravery. These are all qualities of a true Hero of Valor...

But you know what no one ever talks about? Style.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/c80a2fd829de0a80db11191ef4f95b458450381e.png"]
You heard me! Imagine running across the fields to brave the enemy – or getting blown to smithereens by a rocket launcher projectile – while looking dripped out to the max. That’s why we’re dropping the Heroes of Valor Decorated Supporter Pack DLC alongside the Early Access launch on the 12th. The pack will retail at $7.99/£6.69/€7.79

Here’s what you’ll get:

2 Full Custom Outfits: Look the part of a true decorated soldier with exclusive, battle-hardened styles that can’t be earned anywhere else, for both Axis & Allies! 

10% XP Boost: Gain experience faster and help your whole lobby level up with a 10% bonus for you and everyone you play with! 

Golden Name Tag: Dominate the leaderboards in style with a prestigious golden name tag, marking you as a true supporter.

We’ve decided to drop along with a supporter’s pack DLC, because a lot of you have been asking for an additional way to support the development of Heroes of Valor. But we didn’t want this to be a simple cosmetics DLC! That’s why we’ve decided to implement the XP boost, so your entire server will be happy about the presence of a Decorated Supporter. Y’know… to silence the fashion police.


That’s all for now! We’re so excited for Thursday! TWO MORE DAYS! 
Fancy Cat Interactive

notes.title: The Heroes of Valor Playtest has ended!
notes.content:
Soldiers,

We’d like to announce that, in the wake of yesterday’s announcement of Heroes of Valor’s Early Access release date on June 12th, the playtest has officially ended!

These past few months have been a lot of fun, and we’re really grateful for your participation in the playtest. We really enjoyed working on this game alongside such an active & dedicated community, using your feedback to tweak, fix, and ultimately make the game better! And we can’t wait to keep collaborating with all of you as we move into Early Access.

For now, we’ll go back to our messy desks to keep working on some new stuff that you’ll get to see at launch on the 12th. We hope you’ll find another activity to fill that HOV-shaped void in your heart. But don’t fill it too much, cause the battle for the top of the leaderboard won’t be an easy one. 

We can’t wait!

Fancy Cat Interactive & Iceberg Interactive

notes.title: Heroes of Valor is dropping into Early Access on June 12th!
notes.content:
Sound the alarms, soldiers!

Heroes of Valor launches into Early Access on June 12th!

The time has come. No more “soon.” No more cryptic hints. We’ve circled a date on the calendar, underlined it twice, and probably shouted it in our sleep! June 12th is the day Heroes of Valor officially enters Early Access.

🎬 Watch the brand-new launch trailer right here:
[previewyoutube=uerFZsMIdxo;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re currently working on an Early Access roadmap that’ll lay out all the exciting features and updates we’ve got planned. Let’s just say, there’s a lot to look forward to. We’ll be sharing that with you very soon!

We’ll be adding a lot of polish in the EA release, giving the game a a fresh new coat of paint. We’ve reworked the UI, overhauled the sound design, improved hit and kill feedback and polished a bunch of other areas – we want the game to look as fresh and shiny as possible.

Finally, to everyone who’s playtested, wishlisted, joined the Discord, or just screamed into their mics in support: thank you! We’re incredibly grateful for the love this project has already received, and we can’t wait to take it to the next level with you.

See you on the battlefields, June 12th.
Fancy Cat Interactive

notes.title: A Small Thank You Note
notes.content:
Listen up, soldiers!

It’s almost been a month since we announced our publishing deal, and we still can’t quite believe how much has happened since. We’ve gained 25.000 Wishlists and our server browser is busier than ever – seriously, we had to add a scrolling feature!

Reading everyone’s excited, nostalgia-tinged comments has been really heartwarming! We had one particular goal with Heroes of Valor: to bring back some of our core gaming memories, playing a type of shooter that just doesn’t seem to be around anymore (if you know you know). We wanted to recapture that old school feeling, and we’re so excited that that resonated with all of you.

Thanks to everyone who’s wishlisted, joined the playtest, and chatted on the Discord! We’re cooking up a lot of exciting stuff, and we’re so hyped to be able to share it with all of you soon.

A bunch of creators from all over the world also covered our little passion project! For the past few weeks, we’ve been watching video after video, and it’s been an absolute thrill to see other people run around the playground we’ve created. From creators we’ve been watching for years, to new discoveries, we wanna thank everyone who’s covered the game so far! 

We’ve decided to share a handful of our favourite YouTube videos right here:

Jackfrags:

[previewyoutube=L80qr2C2WBE;full][/previewyoutube]
AngryJoeShow:

[previewyoutube=xMQruXo8NfY;full][/previewyoutube]
Dr_Horse (🇫🇷):

[previewyoutube=GhyPI78oyw4;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=QchZxPjEk40;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=iJ9U5Rd_cWE;full][/previewyoutube]
But enough with the procrastination. Thank you for now, but we need to get back to work. We have a lot of incredibly cool stuff coming down the pipeline, and we can’t wait to get you all to see it. Don’t forget: if you wanna get a few behind-the-scenes looks at what we’re working on, or give us feedback or suggestions, Discord is your best bet!

Until then, good luck blasting each other and those bots to bits.

WixZ & Frenzygator
Fancy Cat Interactive

notes.title: We Have A Publisher Now!
notes.content:
Listen up, soldiers!

We have some brand-new recruits joining our playtest and we need you to show them the ropes! 

Some of them have just gotten the call to arms, and are wet behind their ears. These little puppy dogs haven’t experienced the thrills of infantry shootouts, the bundled might of a tank standoff, or the deafening howl of a dogfight. Whether Axis or Allies, they’re lost souls! Cover them on the fields during a Coastal Conflict, and protect them from those nefarious Recons in Valor Village. This war isn’t lost yet. 

To all our new recruits: Welcome to Heroes of Valor. Please don’t embarrass yourselves. And if you do, make it look cool at least. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45184239/831dd993f14bc7d66038f84520582c53a61018fc.png

Leading up to the full release of Heroes of Valor, we’ve decided to join forces with our friends at Iceberg Interactive! Making a game is hard, especially for a two-man team. We felt like it has become increasingly tough to balance working on the game and getting it in front of as many eyes as possible. And that’s why we decided to partner with Iceberg Interactive! They’ll be able to focus on the marketing side of things, while we can keep coming up with crazy ideas for our little shooter!

We’ve worked with Iceberg in the past — they published Blazing Sails, the pirate Battle Royale we worked on at Get Up Games — and we think this collaboration is going to be a fruitful one! We’ll be spitballing ideas together, collaborating on cool content, and making sure the game gets to hit with the full impact of a rocket launcher! 

Ultimately, what you’ll get is a bunch of new friends to play with, or, a bunch of new enemies to tank smash. We’re very excited for what’s to come!

See you on the battlefields,

Fancy Cat Interactive
